clue.text: 6 or 24 for some American players, peripherally defined

definitions.text: 6 or 24 for some American players, peripherally defined

parts.words: 6 or 24 for some American players, peripherally defined
parts.note: 6 across names gems as precious stones, and 24 across names the baseball infields where American players play; 'peripherally defined' points to letters round the edge of the grid

explanation.surface: A puzzling reference to sports grounds in America, described by their edges.
explanation.walkthrough: Cross-references: 6 across is STONES and 24 across is FIELDS. 'peripherally defined' points to a hidden feature in the letters round the edge of the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both precious gems and baseball infields, the two senses given by cross-reference.

clue.text: Sharks in harbours

definitions.meaning: nurse sharks are a family of bottom-dwelling sharks
to harbour a grudge is to keep it alive, to tend or cherish it

explanation.surface: Predators lurking in ports.
explanation.definitionFit: A plural noun for a kind of shark, and a verb meaning to cherish or keep a feeling going.

clue.text: Use a particular number showing energy on the increase

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece set on another sits above it, so energy comes first

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: Someone applies a certain figure that reveals energy growing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is not a figure here but something that numbs: an anaesthetic. Ether is a particular one.
explanation.definitionFit: To etherise is to anaesthetise with ether, a specific drug that makes a patient numb.

clue.text: Blackening popular ruler

parts.note: something in fashion or popular is 'in'
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A well-liked monarch's reputation is being smeared.
explanation.definitionFit: Covering something with ink turns it black, so this is a present participle synonym.

clue.text: Indication of intelligence in, for example, this coterie

indicators.note: the measure of brains is put in the word for this puzzle line

parts.note: the very thing being read, this line of the puzzle, is an example of a clue
IQ, intelligence quotient, is a measure that indicates intelligence

explanation.surface: This exclusive circle is described as a sign of brains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for example, this' means the clue itself: this is a CLUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a small exclusive group of people; a direct synonym.

clue.text: What's in 1 that's good for dating?

definitions.text: What's in 1 that's good for dating?

parts.words: What's in 1 that's good for dating?
parts.note: 1 down is DIAMONDS, which are made of a pure chemical element; a radioactive isotope of that element lets scientists work out the age of ancient remains

explanation.walkthrough: 'dating' suggests romance, and diamonds as gifts, but it means radiocarbon dating of old organic material.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamond is pure crystallised element six, and its isotope C-14 is used to date archaeological finds.

clue.text: British group informally making lots of pounds

definitions.meaning: the Rolling ..., British rock band, are informally shortened to their last word
a stone is a British weight unit of fourteen pounds, so several are many pounds

explanation.surface: A British band earns plenty of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pounds' looks like money, but it is weight: a stone is a British unit equal to 14 pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The band's casual short name, and the plural of a fourteen-pound unit of weight.

clue.text: Drive away from Tennessee office

indicators.note: the answer is taken out from within the run of words Tennessee office

explanation.surface: Someone drives off from an office in Tennessee.
explanation.definitionFit: To see off an intruder is to chase or drive them away; an idiom.

clue.text: Need concert arranged? Staged reunion

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are arranged in a new order, as music is arranged

explanation.surface: A band needs a concert to stage its comeback reunion.
explanation.definitionFit: To have staged a reunion is to have joined up again with others, i.e. come back into contact.

clue.text: French fighter I arm as ordered, somehow

indicators.note: the letters are put in a fresh order in some way or other

explanation.surface: A French soldier arms himself as instructed.
explanation.definitionFit: Aramis is one of Dumas's Three Musketeers, a French swordsman.

clue.text: I said vessel will do for cosmetic

indicators.note: said signals that the letter I is to be heard as a word of the same sound

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like EYE
a liner is an ocean-going ship

explanation.surface: Someone declares that a ship will suit the purpose of a beauty product.
explanation.definitionFit: A make-up product drawn along the lash line to outline the eyes.

clue.text: Kind of garment it's good to have

parts.note: to own is to have

explanation.surface: Some item of clothing is worth possessing.
explanation.definitionFit: A long dress or robe, as worn at a formal ball or by academics.

clue.text: Ostentatious behaviour in small house, part of building belonging to female

parts.note: a wing is a section of a building
of expresses belonging, as in the house of my aunt

explanation.surface: A woman shows off in a tiny home that has its own extension.
explanation.definitionFit: Flaunting yourself to impress others is exactly what ostentation means.

clue.text: Harshness of Australian reduced when in power

indicators.note: placed within the word for power

parts.note: agency means power or force acting to produce an effect

indicators.note: the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: Strine is a jocular name for Australian English

explanation.surface: An Australian's severity lessens once they are in office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' trims STRINE to STRIN, which goes 'in' AGENCY.
explanation.definitionFit: Astringency is sharpness or severity of manner or taste, so a synonym for harshness.

clue.text: Punishments for serious offences getting one down, for example

definitions.meaning: in football a referee shows a red card to send a player off for a serious foul
1 down is the suit of diamonds, which with hearts are the playing cards printed in red

explanation.surface: Penalties for grave crimes include bringing someone down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one down' is a cross-reference to 1 down, DIAMONDS, not a foul on a player.
explanation.definitionFit: Sending-off cards in sport, and red-suited playing cards such as diamonds.

clue.text: Cotton fabric being worn, new in island

indicators.note: the pieces go in the island's name

parts.note: Crete is a Greek island
clothes being worn are on

explanation.surface: A cotton cloth, still new, is being worn on a Greek island.
explanation.definitionFit: Cretonne is a heavy printed cotton cloth used for upholstery and curtains.

clue.text: Overwhelm with English disease turning up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: flu, influenza, is a disease

explanation.surface: An English illness appears and overpowers someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To engulf is to swamp or swallow up completely; a synonym.

clue.text: Letter from Greek doctor and I showing figures found on 14

parts.note: rho is the Greek letter R
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A Greek physician writes a letter featuring geometric shapes.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 down is RED CARDS: the diamond pips printed on such playing cards are rhombus shapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhombi are four-sided equal-edged shapes, the diamond pips on playing cards.

clue.text: Temperature in cider isn't changing in bars

indicators.note: the temperature letter is put in the rearranged words
the letters of the two words keep changing their order

explanation.surface: Warming cider somehow doesn't alter it in pubs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bars' looks like pubs, matching the cider, but it is a verb meaning forbids.
explanation.definitionFit: To interdict is to prohibit formally, so the third-person verb is a synonym for bars.

clue.text: What can be found in Tate, namely a work of art

indicators.note: the answer can be found running inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Asking what artwork is on display at the Tate gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate is the London art gallery, so the surface fits its definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An enamel can be a decorative piece made of glassy coating fused to metal, a work of art.

clue.text: Hitch in vehicle heading north in part of city

indicators.note: in a down clue, heading north means reading upwards
the hitch goes inside the vehicle

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle
a rub is a hitch or difficulty, as in 'there's the rub'

explanation.surface: A breakdown on a bus travelling north to a district of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: BRUBUS, the bus around the rub, is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A suburb is an outlying residential district of a city.

clue.text: Part of speech that's authentic

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Grammar talk: some part of speech is genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: Echt is a German borrowing meaning genuine or typical, used in English.

clue.text: Fugitive has to rush a barrier

parts.note: to run is to rush
a gate is a barrier

explanation.surface: An escapee must charge at a barricade.
explanation.definitionFit: Runagate is an archaic word for a runaway or deserter.

clue.text: They are pushed to clean bachelor accommodation

parts.note: rooms are lodgings or accommodation

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to tidy a single man's lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pushed' suggests people being urged to clean, but it describes the sweeping tools.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-handled brushes are pushed across a floor to sweep it clean.

clue.text: Disciplines daughter and son at end of reformed life

indicators.note: the two letters are placed at the end of the rearranged word
the word life is formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: Children bring order at the close of a reformed life.
explanation.definitionFit: Fields are areas of study or subjects, as disciplines are.

clue.text: Ancient character in British island, or part of one

indicators.note: the character sits within the two abbreviations

parts.note: a rune is a letter of an ancient Germanic alphabet

explanation.surface: An old letter found on a British island, or somewhere on one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to 'island': Brunei occupies part of the island of Borneo.
explanation.definitionFit: Brunei is a small sultanate occupying a section of Borneo, so it is a portion of an island.
